_why: SHRINK-ONLY RATCHET for database-level WORM (void-not-delete) coverage on financial tables. ACCT-F141 made 9 tables physically undeletable after 139 real rows were destroyed on prod and could not be recovered; its header promised this ratchet and it was never written, so the control had nothing watching it. protected_tables is absolute — losing any entry is RED. unprotected_count may only DECREASE.
_rules: Never remove a table from protected_tables. WORM is one-way.
Never RAISE unprotected_count to make a build pass — decide whether the new table needs WORM.
Lowering unprotected_count after adding protection is the goal, not the exception.
